t.E300.agn: In 2015 EFSA saw no need for a numerical acceptable daily intake (ADI) and found no safety concern at the reported use levels.
t.E300.body: Ascorbic acid is vitamin C; it acts as an antioxidant in the body, and any excess is excreted in the urine.
t.E300.prod: Produced from glucose by fermentation and chemical steps; it is the same molecule as vitamin C found in nature.
t.E300.regx.0: Re-evaluated; no numerical ADI needed, no safety concern.
t.E300.summary: Vitamin C. As an antioxidant it prevents colour deterioration in fruit juices and meat products, and it is a flour treatment agent in bread.
t.E300.what: It is vitamin C itself; by slowing oxidation it prevents deterioration of colour and flavour, and when added to flour it strengthens the dough.
